meta.title: Shared blackboards
meta.description: Two collaboration surfaces for your sessions: agent group chat (chat rooms between you and several sessions or workspaces, Markdown bubbles, avatars, @-mentions that actively wake members) and blackboards (shared Markdown documents where everyone reads freely and edits serialize through a queue that always hands you the latest content). Boards can be opened for a whole workspace: sessions created there register automatically, archived or closed sessions are recorded and cut off from communication, and every session knows its own positioning through an identity card and the blackboard_whoami tool. Sessions are named workspace-session.
